encoding_variations: property_issue_type is catalog enum with enum_values: null — issuers write prose. Degrade to str.
Property may be identified by street address, APN, or legal description — property_address + parcel_or_apn together disambiguate.
rental_or_vacancy_details is an object — flatten to a string; the model states it as prose.

open_questions.q: facts_and_chronology / transfer dates typed vs catch-all.
open_questions.recommendation: catch-all — no consumer; flag if occupancy/flip rules later need a typed timeline GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

open_questions.q: Subject vs non-subject property. There is no subject_property_indicator in this catalog (unlike 084). Should we add one so occupancy logic knows which property the letter explains?
open_questions.recommendation: add as [absent from catalog] if occupancy rules materialize GEET'S DECISION (LP-439): ADD subject_property_indicator so occupancy logic knows which property the LOE addresses.

open_questions.q: property_address when multiple properties are named.
open_questions.recommendation: kept as a single flattened address; revisit as a list only if a letter routinely covers several properties GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

notes: No rules in the packet → no rule floor. A borrower letter explaining a property-related question (occupancy, vesting, address history, prior transactions, condition). Typed core anchors the property and the issue so the letter can be attached to the right property; the narrative falls to the catch-all. Every field justified by identity, disambiguation, or processor review.
loan_number (confidential) treated as identity/linkage, not registered. No SSN/DOB/account number on this document type.

Ambiguity: address_mismatch_orhistory is tagged 'processor/disambiguator'; classified as processor (first-listed primary) — the disambiguation reading is also defensible. signature_date is tagged 'execution', not one of the five classes; classified as processor as best guess.
